payload.title: Issue ACM certificates for CloudFront custom domains
payload.description:
ACM certificates in us-east-1 (CloudFront requirement). DNS validation records in the Route 53 hosted zone from the previous task.

At minimum: chattic.us and www.chattic.us for production web. Add api.chattic.us (or chosen API hostname) if the routing decision uses a subdomain.

Wire certificate ARNs into the web and thin-turn CDK stacks as parameters or cross-stack references.
